step: LTE-1 step 2 — gates on the REAL Qwen host (literal 2.2 scoring, literal 2.3 features)
protocol: docs/LTE_PROTOCOL.md Revision 8 (commit 57b1fef; owner ruling 2026-11-26: Gate-1 comparison criterion evaluated in float64 over cached fixed host outputs, float32 pair recorded as diagnostic; built on frozen Revision 6 + Rev 7, commits 7b7642c2..., f1a4a02)
rerun_note: attempt 1 (Rev-7 criteria) kernel-OOM-killed in the float64 Gate-1 block (dmesg 12:57:38, 28.9 GB RSS); attempt 2 (Rev-8, host released) STILL OOM-killed (13:33:10, 29.4 GB RSS) — the autograd matmul retained its head operand, so the per-candidate float64 head cast accumulated 8 x 3.1 GB in the criterion graph; attempt 3 (this run) persists ONE shared float64 head view (aliased, not copied, by the cast), releases the frozen host before the gates, chunks the criterion backward per fact (exact — self-check recorded), and records peak RSS per milestone; swap on the host is FULL (7/7 GB), so peak RSS is kept well under the ~29 GB level at which the kernel OOM-killer fired

fixture_state_construction.construction_rationale: hinge active at the literal seeded state

l2_interface_pathway.bound_note: host pathway casts the residual to the BF16 logit dtype before the head matmul (interface.py:292-300); the achievable agreement is that cast (~2^-8 relative), so the assertion bound is the cast-consistent 2e-2 — the actual max diff is recorded and the exact float32 mirror math is verified at L1

gate1.criterion: Rev 8 (commit 57b1fef): |D_AD - D_FD(eps)| / max(1, |D_AD|) <= max(10 * n_rep, 1e-4) at eps in {1e-2, 1e-3}, with the comparison evaluated in FLOAT64 over cached fixed host outputs (the host forward is never re-run in float64). The float32 pair is recorded as a diagnostic only.

float32_diagnostic.note: diagnostic only under Revision 8 — the pass criterion is the float64 comparison; this records the float32 production-dtype pair

grad_chunking_selfcheck.note: chunked backward verified IDENTICAL to the whole-graph backward

chunk_record.note: chunked backward: rank term accumulated per fact with the lambda_r/n factor (exact mean), disc term whole; mathematically identical to one backward of F (verified by self-check)

precision_audit.float64_meaning: The float64 calculation is a higher-precision evaluation of the defined plastic objective over fixed host outputs; the host forward itself remains in its native precision — this is NOT float64 Qwen inference.

reproducibility.load_call: AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODEL_DIR, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, low_cpu_mem_usage=True, device_map=None, local_files_only=True).to('cpu'); eval(); freeze_base; foundation_fingerprint — exactly teacher_student.setup_foundation --foundation qwen

rng.seed_stream: torch.manual_seed(20261126) at fixture __init__, BEFORE interface construction (relationship W draws deterministic); torch.manual_seed(20261133) (= SEED+7) for the literal-state diagnostic draw

reproducibility.pair_selection: pick_hook_pairs yielded 3 pairs [(0, 1), (3, 4), (30, 31)]; first 4 requested -> extended in the function's own family-walk pattern with second-occurrence pair(s) [(2, 3)] (fixture choice, recorded)

feature_extraction.spec: LTE protocol section 2.3, implemented literally for the real host: per-fact feature = gamma-scaled plastic residual at the answer position from that fact's own connection set only (masked residual sum — every connection outside the set contributes EXACTLY ZERO); float32 cosine; zero-norm vector => cos exactly 0 (explicit norm check)
feature_extraction.carrier_context: fact i's own carrier context = its prompt + gold-candidate ids (the fact's canonical scoring context); connection i's psi on that context
feature_extraction.answer_position_definition: the interface broadcasts one residual vector per sequence; the answer-position feature is that vector as received at the answer positions prompt_len-1 .. prompt_len-1+len(cand_ids)-1

u_state.construction_rationale: hinge active at the literal seeded state
